system.description:
Millennia of passivity in the face of opposition breed an indomitable constitution. Vampires with this power have been known to rise from Final Death: severed limbs and appendages reattach themselves, and even a severed head reknits itself to the neck. Anyone attempting to destroy a Cappadocian who commands this power had best be certain the job is truly done, or she may find herself with a powerful, very long-term enemy.

System: When this power activates, the vampire must spend all remaining Blood Traits (if any) and four Willpower Traits, plus one additional Willpower Trait for each severed limb or the head that must be rejoined. If she lacks sufficient Willpower, she suffers Final Death as normal. Severed body parts must be physically near the corpse, as they mystically crawl back to rejoin it. The vampire is healed up to the Mauled Health Level and should seek out somewhere to recover further. Enacting this power permanently costs the vampire one dot from every Attribute, crossed off and never recoverable, lowering her maximum Trait ratings accordingly. This power activates automatically and immediately whenever the triggering condition (Final Death) occurs, though a canny attacker may still interfere if she realizes what is happening. Catastrophic destruction (immolation, sunlight, and the like) remains beyond this power's ability to reverse.
system.source: Clanbook: Cappadocian, Chapter Three: Observations and Conclusions
